title: Retain the earlier exactly certified two-band optimum as a concrete benchmark
statement: At theta=1/2 and m0=1, the source defines dual root c in (4,5), K=(c^2-3)/4, M=4-12/c^2 and side spring k=4(M-1)/M. Bands [0,1] union [2,c] globally minimize the full Bose functional over the same K,M and all admitted internal networks with m>=1. The exact rational benefit certificate exceeds 29/100 in normalized J relative to the rigid chain.
